summary: Visa living-cost funds rise for applications from 30 Nov 2026; Budget news on a two-year Graduate visa at 'high-compliance' universities still needs GOV.UK confirmation; no new UCAS release.

items.title: Student visa maintenance funds rise from 30 Nov 2026
items.what: Applications from 30 Nov 2026 must show £1,570/month in London (was £1,529) and £1,203/month outside London (was £1,171); 9-month maximum £14,130 / £10,827. Applications before 30 Nov use the old amounts. Visa fee £558; IHS £776/year.

items.title: Budget: two-year Graduate visa kept for 'high-compliance' universities; £925 levy confirmed for Aug 2028
items.source: Times Higher Education / Amber Student (needs GOV.UK confirmation)
items.what: Reports say the 28 Oct 2026 Budget keeps two-year Graduate visas only at high-compliance universities; the standard route was set to fall to 18 months from Jan 2027. Start date and definition not confirmed. £925 per-student levy on universities from Aug 2028.

items.title: UCAS: no new release this week
items.what: Latest figures are from the Jan 2026 deadline: 124,830 international applicants (+5.1%); China remains the largest early-deadline market.
